summary: Uni-Fuels Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held on June 8, 2026. Shareholders approved four proposals: increasing voting rights of Class B shares from 10 to 100 votes per share; increasing authorized share capital from US$50,000 to US$500,000 by creating additional ordinary shares; adopting amended articles of association; and authorizing a reverse share split up to 250:1. This is a routine corporate governance event—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation is disclosed. The filing is purely a shareholder vote outcome report with no transactional terms.
